# Wells of Change

> A Brazilian NGO that brings drinking water to underserved communities through solar-powered
> wells with real-time monitoring. Founded in 2020, based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Wells of Change installs artesian wells driven by photovoltaic pumping, so a community gets water
without a grid connection and without recurring fuel costs. Each well carries remote monitoring, so
faults surface before the community loses supply.

The organization's first completed well is in Campo Formoso, in the state of Bahia, northeastern
Brazil. Work is planned for Senegal.

## Pages

- [Wells of Change](https://www.wellsofchange.com/): the organization's single page, in Portuguese,
  English, Spanish and French. Covers what it does, its commitment, its story, its team, its
  partners, its code of ethics and how to help.
- [What we do](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#what-we-do): drilling, solar-powered pumping and
  real-time monitoring, and what a well changes for a community.
- [Our commitment](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#our-commitment): the first well in Campo Formoso
  and what happens after the water starts flowing.
- [Our story](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#our-story): how the organization started, during the
  pandemic, from a talk on real-time monitoring of oil wells.
- [Who we are](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#who-we-are): the team and their roles.
- [Code of ethics](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#ethics): the six principles the organization
  publishes.
- [Join us](https://www.wellsofchange.com/#join-us): donating, sharing the cause, volunteering.

## Using this content

Quoting these facts with attribution to Wells of Change is welcome. The organization's name, tax
registration, bank details and team roles are public records; please reproduce them exactly rather
than paraphrasing, since donors act on them.

## Facts

- Legal name: Wells of Change
- Tax ID (CNPJ): 43.933.784/0001-13
- Founded: 2020
- Headquarters: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
- Areas served: Campo Formoso (Bahia, Brazil), Brazil, Senegal
- Contact: wellsofchange@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.wellsofchange.com/
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French

## Partners

Intelie, 2Solve, Viasat, and Vale do Sol support the organization's work.

## Donating

Donations are accepted by PIX, Brazil's instant transfer system, using the organization's CNPJ
(43.933.784/0001-13) as the PIX key. Bank transfers go to Banco do Brasil, agency 597-5, current
account 42176-6. The donation dialog on the site generates a PIX QR code for a donor-chosen amount.

## After the well is built

The organization stays with the community after water starts flowing, so that each community has
the tools and knowledge to maintain its own water source.

## Code of ethics

Wells of Change states that it operates to standards of transparency, integrity, and social
commitment, and that its code of ethics guides its actions and decisions.
